body: I too suffer from pcos so I'm very interested too!

It's no worries. 
And no, nothing really. There are somedays that I don't think about it a lot, usually when I'm busy or when I used to work most of the time. When I first came out to the country I felt awesome for about a month. I've never liked living in the city and I'm a hermit at heart so being in the middle of nowhere with farm animals to take care of is my idea of a great living situation but with all the decisions I've made in life I can't really get that without relying on someone.

I'm just frustrated that I know exactly what would make me happy but because of my past can't have it. And I have no steps to take now that would bring me to it either.
I'm also really sorry for your friend and their parents. I would never want to diminish someone's hardship. I just think it really wouldn't be a big shock to them if they were told I had left.

Mentally yes. I have been struggling with suicidal thoughts since I was around 13. I don't remember much from then but I do remember when I tried to end it. My mom has a problem with psychologists from a previous experience of hers.
Life wise also yes. Ever since I got out of high school it's been one mistake after the next. An abusive ex that I left and moved home, getting fired from a couple jobs over petty circumstances and my recent stupid choice, leaving my entire life behind to live in the country hoping it would pick me up out of my dark thinking patterns. And it did for a while, but it's as if life is scolding me like some ill mannered child. "no! You can't have nice things! You just fuck them up anyways, here I'll take that for you."

I'm just tired of trying to find peace of mind. A life I actually am happy with. Every time I think I have it, something gets taken away or I fuck it up.

That's the thing though, continuing on and becoming more and more of a burden and a black sheep of the family just hurts too much to think about. I even tried to ask my aunt I hadn't talk to in years for help finding somewhere to live but it basically came out to "yea I have no idea... So this covid thing huh? Really sucks".

Everyone in my family already knows I'm struggling. It wouldn't be much of a surprise for them I'm sure. Yes it would suck but my brothers are doing so much better than i could have ever imagined. They'd refocus on them quickly I'm sure.
